blocks.html: Watch a live stream in VLC media player with a ready-made file from Deploy App.

slides.title: Install VLC
slides.html:
• Install VLC media player, version 3.0 or newer
  • Get it from videolan.org or your device's app store

slides.title: Open the stream in Deploy App
slides.html:
• Open Deploy App
  • Go to Home and launch MTX
  • Select a stream marked LIVE

slides.title: Download the VLC package
slides.html:
• Select Connection Options
  • Under Download Packages, press VLC
  • Deploy App downloads a file that ends in .m3u

slides.title: Open the package in VLC
slides.html:
• Open the downloaded .m3u file with VLC
  • On a computer: Media → Open File
  • The stream starts playing
  • The file contains your password and the SRT passphrase: do not share it, and delete it when you no longer need it

slides.title: If the stream does not open
slides.html:
• In Connection Options, open Advanced Links
  • Copy the HLS address and add /index.m3u8 to the end
  • On a computer: in VLC, go to Media → Open Network Stream, paste the address and press Play
  • On a phone: in VLC, go to More → Streams → New Stream, paste the address in Enter network address and start playback

slides.title: You can now watch a stream in VLC
slides.html:
• You can close this guide.

To watch in your browser instead, see Browser
